statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0247 is an informational notice that the bitmaps crate is unmaintained (repository archived 2026-05-03) and names no vulnerability and no patched release. bitmaps 3.2.1 comes into ddtrace's Rust extension through libdatadog's profiling library; replacing it needs an upstream libdatadog change.

bitmaps 3.2.1 is compiled into ddtrace's Rust extension (ddtrace/internal/native/_native) through libdatadog's profiling library. The flaw is that Bitmap::try_from(&[u8]) and the AsMut<[u8]> implementation can write a byte that is not a valid bool into a Bitmap<1>. The only Bitmap in the extension is a Bitmap<32> in the profiler's upscaling rules, whose backing store is a u32; the code creates it with Default and uses only set and get.
